## 2. Flagship Systems Engineered by Cyprian Ocharo

### A. SkolarTrak SIS & E-Library (skolartrak.com)
- **Domain:** https://skolartrak.com
- **Description:** A production-grade multi-tenant Student Information System and CBC Digital Revision E-Library purpose-built for Kenyan primary schools and Junior Secondary Schools (JSS).
- **Core Problem Solved:** Replaces paper registers, manual cash/bank fee receipting, and spreadsheet report forms with an integrated digital workflow.
- **Architectural Highlights:**
  - **4-Rubric CBC Evaluation:** Automated rubric score calculations (EE - Exceeding Expectations, ME - Meeting Expectations, AE - Approaching Expectations, BE - Below Expectations) aligned with KNEC CBA guidelines.
  - **Fintech Integration:** Real-time Safaricom M-Pesa STK push via IntaSend webhooks, automatically reconciling fee payments against individual student ledgers with zero manual receipt entry.
  - **Automated SMS Communications:** Direct integration with Advanta Africa SMS gateway to broadcast fee balance reminders, attendance alerts, and exam notices to parents.
  - **Security & Integrity:** Staged approval mechanisms for front-office secretary submissions to prevent unauthorized data tampering; strict Role-Based Access Control.
  - **E-Library:** Revision papers, study notes, schemes of work, and AI-powered study assistance for CBC learners and educators.

### B. DreamRoots Kenya Consultancy (dreamrootskenya.com / dreamroots.vercel.app)
- **Domain:** https://dreamrootskenya.com
- **Mirror:** https://dreamroots.vercel.app
- **Description:** Official corporate platform for DreamRoots Kenya, a premier strategic advisory firm offering management consultancy, HR strategy, ICT solutions, and educational research.
- **Stack:** React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, Swiper.
- **Architectural Highlights:** High accessibility scores, rapid LCP load times, interactive service catalog, executive team showcases, and structured consultation booking.

### C. SafariTrak
- **Description:** Real-time traveler tracking and trip safety monitoring application designed for regional transit routes in East Africa.
- **Stack:** PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, Leaflet Maps, Tailwind CSS.
- **Key Modules:** Journey live location broadcasting, trusted contact alerts, driver check-in verification, and group transit coordination.
